description: Stale local cumulative recovered by a single retry against the server's authoritative state.

initialState.comment: Client believes the channel is fresh (e.g. restarted from disk and lost local state); server has already charged 100 from prior requests that have not yet been claimed onchain.

steps.action: POST a paid request with a voucher signed against the stale local cumulative.

voucher.signature: <placeholder; voucher signing semantics pinned by byte-equivalence fixtures in #2489>

steps.action: Reject the voucher (server.chargedCumulativeAmount ≥ voucher.maxClaimableAmount) and return the authoritative channel state.

Verify totalClaimed against the onchain BatchSettlement.channels(channelId) call. Replace local cumulative with chargedCumulativeAmount (100). Sign a new voucher with maxClaimableAmount = chargedCumulativeAmount + requestCharge = 110. Retry exactly once.
Accept the retried voucher. Advance server chargedCumulativeAmount to 110.

expectedClientBehaviour.afterStep2: Detect corrective 402, parse channelState, verify totalClaimed against onchain BatchSettlement.channels(channelId), replace local cumulative with chargedCumulativeAmount, sign new voucher, retry exactly once. Emit telemetry label recovery.stale_state.
expectedClientBehaviour.afterStep4: Accept response. Effective charge for this request = requestCharge = 10. Update local cumulative to 110.

invariants: The client must verify totalClaimed against the onchain channel state before trusting chargedCumulativeAmount; the server's value is only used to advance the local cumulative ceiling, never to confirm onchain truth.
Retry happens at most once. A second corrective 402 must escalate to a hard error (see loop-guard.json).
